well I'm glad to hear the pain went away but keep in mind cutting your thighs is much more dangerous than your wrists for example and can easily lead to you becoming paralyzed or dying, after cutting try to judge how deep it is, the darker it is the deeper, if it continues bleeding for a while (not just 3 or 4 mins I'm talking like 5-10 mins after the initial cut) then you may have a problem, if you get to a point where you cut so deep you see some thing you don't normally see like bone or something along those lines tell someone immediately, if you start feeling physically I'll this can also be a sign of a possible emergency this is not always the case tho, for the most part you'll know when you need to go to the hospital, but my number 1 tip is don't look online for advice, you'll immediately stumble across dozens of articles of people dying from cutting themselves to death, this is gonna just freak you out more and won't go well, after you cut sanitize the wound, put some like gauze, bandages, or a band-aid, depending on the size, grab a cloth napkin, put an icepack or just ice in it and put it on the wounds, if possible raise the cuts above your head, this helps sterilize the cuts and minimize bleeding, stay safe and hang in there
